_storage_key_strategy: Each of the 165 assets below is uploaded to R2 exactly once, under the stable key seed/library/{manifest_id}.{ext} recorded as this entry's storage_key, with cdn_url = {MEDIA_CDN_BASE_URL}/{storage_key}. media_assets.storage_key is UNIQUE, so when a downstream seeder (Task 5's MediaSeedWriter) creates a media_assets row for a given owner that reuses one of these manifest entries, it must mint its own fresh users/{ownerId}/media/{uuid}.{ext}-shaped storage_key (matching app.media.storage-key-pattern / MediaStorageKeyGenerator) to satisfy the constraint, but it writes back this manifest entry's single real cdn_url so every reader gets a working image without re-uploading the physical asset.

_topic_notes.fake-investment: scam/fraud concept has no direct photographic representation; substituted financial chart imagery commonly used in scam-warning content
_topic_notes.freelance-work: abstract labor arrangement; substituted concrete freelancer-at-work imagery
_topic_notes.gold-price: abstract price/market concept; substituted concrete gold bullion imagery
_topic_notes.job-market: abstract labor-market concept; substituted concrete interview imagery
_topic_notes.property-price: abstract price/market concept; substituted concrete real-estate imagery
_topic_notes.travel-work: abstract remote-work-while-travelling concept; substituted concrete digital-nomad imagery
_topic_notes._banner_pool_note: Only 15 users in the current users.json carry a creator/small_business persona_id (p03_photographer_freelance=6, p05_shop_owner_clothes=5, p07_fnb_owner=4). 25 banner objects are provisioned per section 3.3 as pool headroom for Task 2's re-linking of posts.json/users.json.
_topic_notes._reclassified_avatar_pool_note: pexels_avatar_091..095 were the 5 unused entries from the former avatar pool (phase4_final_report.md documented them as "referenced from posts.json instead"). Phase 5 removed avatars from the manifest entirely (avatars are now literal randomuser.me URLs, see users.json), but these 5 specific ids are real post_media references (post_0291 among them) that must keep resolving, so they were reclassified role=avatar -> role=post and moved into images rather than deleted.
